Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 27b (logging-only visibility round). Edit ONLY tools/server-restart.mjs. This is a sensitive process-kill and lock file (stale-lock takeover, lock release/refresh, and the SIGTERM of a replacement that failed to start), so an Opus review follows. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, exports, lock behavior, signals, command output, or tests. No refactors or reformatting.

Audit: docs/state/silent-failures.md. These line numbers are CURRENT in origin/main 1.167.28 (0aef30b) and the file is unchanged since the audit. Locate each catch by the quoted code; bind the error exactly as described. Keep the same fallback/return value and the same lock/signal behavior after every change.

Rules:
- SILENT-<CODE>: stay silent when error?.code === '<CODE>'. Log anything else with fixed, bounded text plus error?.code / error?.name. Never log error.message for a SyntaxError from a lock or registry file.
- LEAVE: make NO change at all to that catch.
- LOG-ALWAYS: log unconditionally with fixed, bounded text plus error?.code / error?.name; never a file path, username, file content, or raw parser message.
- For .catch(() => value) forms, the new handler must return the same value.
- Cleanup closes and intentional fallbacks stay untouched (LEAVE).

Per-catch specification (file order):

1. line 65: `} catch { /* already gone */ }` in removeRegistryRecord (JSON read + rm). SILENT-ENOENT. Bind error. If error?.code === 'ENOENT' stay silent; if error instanceof SyntaxError log '[tools/server-restart.mjs] corrupt registry (SyntaxError)'; otherwise log '[tools/server-restart.mjs] removeRegistryRecord:', error?.code ?? error?.name ?? 'unknown'. Keep the existing return behavior.

2. line 240: `} catch { /* no versions dir */ }` around readdirSync(versionsDir). SILENT-ENOENT. Bind error. If error?.code !== 'ENOENT', console.error('[tools/server-restart.mjs] versions dir:', error?.code ?? 'unknown'). Keep the existing out array.

3. line 330: `} catch { /* fall through */ }` after the first `ps -o args=` probe. LEAVE (intentional fallback).

4. line 350: `} catch { /* start time unknown */ }` after the `ps -o etime=` probe. LEAVE (intentional fallback).

5. line 357: `} catch { /* start time unknown */ }` after the `ps -o lstart=` probe. LEAVE (intentional fallback).

6. line 438: `} catch { /* fall through */ }` after fs.access(current). LEAVE (intentional fallback).

7. line 444: `} catch { /* fall through */ }` after fs.access(versioned). LEAVE (intentional fallback).

8. line 506: `} catch { /* not ready */ }` inside pollRemoteFile. LEAVE (polling loop; expected while a file is being written).

9. line 524: `} catch { /* not ready */ }` inside pollBoardRecord. LEAVE (polling loop).

10. line 633: `} catch { /* lock path absent after rename — expected */ }` in the stale-lock takeover. SILENT-ENOENT. Bind error. If error?.code === 'ENOENT' stay silent; if error instanceof SyntaxError log '[tools/server-restart.mjs] corrupt lock (SyntaxError)'; otherwise log '[tools/server-restart.mjs] stale lock re-read:', error?.code ?? error?.name ?? 'unknown'. Keep the following `await fs.rm(stolen); return true;` exactly.

11. line 649: `} catch { /* already gone */ }` in releaseProcessLock. SILENT-ENOENT. Bind error. If error?.code === 'ENOENT' stay silent; if error instanceof SyntaxError log '[tools/server-restart.mjs] corrupt lock (SyntaxError)'; otherwise log '[tools/server-restart.mjs] releaseProcessLock:', error?.code ?? error?.name ?? 'unknown'. Keep the same release behavior.

12. line 668: `void refresh(lockPath, ownerIdentity).catch(() => {});` in startProcessLockRefresh. SILENT-ENOENT. Change the handler to `.catch(error => { if (error?.code !== 'ENOENT') console.error('[tools/server-restart.mjs] lock refresh:', error?.code ?? error?.name ?? 'unknown'); })`. Keep `void` and the timer behavior.

13. line 682: `await fs.mkdir(path.dirname(lockPath), { recursive: true }).catch(() => {});` in withProcessLock. LOG-ALWAYS. Change the handler to `.catch(error => { console.error('[tools/server-restart.mjs] process lock dir:', error?.code ?? error?.name ?? 'unknown'); })`. Still await it and keep the lock loop unchanged.

14. line 708: `await handle.close().catch(() => {});` in the withProcessLock finally. LEAVE (cleanup close).

15. line 748: `if (logFd !== null) { try { closeSync(logFd); } catch { /* closed */ } }` in the child error handler. LEAVE (cleanup close).

16. line 753: `try { closeSync(logFd); } catch { /* parent must not keep fd open */ }` after spawn. LEAVE (cleanup close).

17. line 836: `} catch { /* already present */ }` around the SWARM_TEST_TMP stub write with `{ flag: 'wx' }`. SILENT-EEXIST. Bind error. If error?.code !== 'EEXIST', console.error('[tools/server-restart.mjs] test stub runner:', error?.code ?? 'unknown'). Keep the behavior.

18. line 844: `} catch { /* no url */ }` in emitBoardUrl. LEAVE (display-only best effort).

19. line 990: `try { killImpl(newPid, 'SIGTERM'); } catch { /* best effort */ }` after a replacement that did not confirm. SILENT-ESRCH. Bind error. If error?.code !== 'ESRCH', console.error('[tools/server-restart.mjs] stop replacement after failed restart:', error?.code ?? error?.name ?? 'unknown'). Keep the same waitForExit and fall-through behavior. (EPERM is logged on purpose: it can mean the process is not ours; the Opus review can judge the darwin zombie case.)

Do not touch any other catch. Forbidden shortcuts: `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` with no real log, `void error`, unused binding.

After editing: run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/server-restart.test.mjs tests/server-restart-round2.test.mjs tests/server-restart-round3.test.mjs tests/server-restart-round4.test.mjs tests/restart-any-server.test.mjs tests/server-record-version.test.mjs tests/server-restart-review.test.mjs tests/fix-1167-13.test.mjs tests/review-high-regressions.test.mjs tests/update-pending-round3.test.mjs tests/split-module.test.mjs`. If a test fails because it asserts empty stderr on one of the newly logged paths, STOP and return blocked with the test name; do not edit a test. Final summary: one line per numbered catch saying changed (with the exact log text) or LEFT, plus the test result.
